title: Configure One-to-Many Relationships using Fluent API
description: Learn to configure one-to-many relationships and cascade delete using Fluent API.

data.text: While EF Core conventions automatically configure one-to-many relationships, you can use Fluent API for explicit configuration and better maintenance.

data.title: One-to-Many Fluent API
data.content: Configuring one-to-many relationship using Fluent API

data.caption: Fluent API one-to-many configuration steps
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[Entity<Student>] --> B[HasOne<Grade>]
    B --> C[WithMany]
    C --> D[HasForeignKey]

items: `.HasOne<Grade>(s => s.Grade)` - Specify the reference navigation property
`.WithMany(g => g.Students)` - Specify the collection navigation property
`.HasForeignKey(s => s.CurrentGradeId)` - Specify the foreign key property

points: Use Fluent API for explicit relationship configuration
Cascade delete removes dependent entities automatically
